EmailTemplate.name: Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP)
EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for contacting ASU College of Nursing and Health Innovation
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the College of Nursing & Health Innovation and the Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) program at Arizona State University. We are proud that our graduate programs rank in the top 4% nationally for best graduate nursing programs (US News & World Report) and are excited that you are considering joining us to further your nursing education.
We are currently accepting applications for our DNP programs for summer/fall 2016 and want to share a few important updates with you:
--The priority application deadline is December 15th. Applications received after this date will be reviewed on a space available basis. --Programs start once per year. Depending on the program, start dates are either summer or fall. --The GRE is no longer required for admission. --Applicants must upload unofficial transcripts from all institutions attended to the DNP supplemental application in PDF format. --A current unencumbered RN license in the state in which you plan to do clinical practicums is required. All students are also required to have an unencumbered Arizona RN license or an unencumbered compact state RN license as mandated by the Arizona State Board of Nursing. Your RN license must remain unencumbered throughout your enrollment in any nursing program. --The application contains detailed instructions regarding your letters of recommendation, resume, goal statement, health and safety requirements, and admissions essay.
We encourage you to explore our DNP specialties online https://nursingandhealth.asu.edu/degree-programs/graduate?degree_type=1 and to apply early to ensure you can complete the application by the priority deadline. and to apply early to ensure you can complete the application by the priority deadline.
Benefits of graduate study at ASU include:
*Grow your career and lead others *Gain broader perspectives on global health challenges *Surround yourself with expert faculty and quality mentors *Prepare to positively impact health outcomes *Apply theory and research to advance practice
Please do not hesitate to contact us. Our team can serve as a resource as you submit your application.
Sincerely,
Recruitment and Admissions College of Nursing and Health Innovation Phone: (602) 496-0937 Office Hours: Monday - Friday, 8 a.m. - 5 p.m. dnpnursing@asu.edu https://nursingandhealth.asu.edu
